sourceFindings: Filer is backup-only source/data copying, JSON/hash/gzip and one exact historical Git-blob read; it imports no product, verifier, browser, original or candidate module.
Distinct fixed finite/browser run jobs and artifacts are checked against the exact completed two-job collection;92 groups and8 cases remain separate counts.

Every reported stored member is identity-checked. Direct aliases omit only32 installed sources,27 dependencies and371/384 active snapshots per job; exact full outer/inner ZIPs retain every byte and each omitted alias identity remains declared.

All19 finite and52 browser nonsource artifact roles remain direct. Both source postchecks and the extra browser census postcheck, synthetic/native downloads, screenshots, raw API/logs and all observer versions remain retained.
Actual34-source installation journal is authenticated to tested362 Git and its then-awaiting-acceptance text is preserved. Historical experimental92/8 results are not rebound.
First CRLF observer failure is disclosed as backup-reader-only; v1 evidence and v2 report/source are retained without claiming a hosted product rerun.
Scope text explicitly limits original helper comparisons, browser matrix, full suite, every-feature, security, parity and superiority claims.
